rating.verdict: An easy-to-pilot go-wide deck: cast creatures, attack, repeat. With no Game Changers, tutors or combos it fits Bracket 2 (Core) and plays well against other preconstructed-level decks.
strengths: Suki makes a new attacking Ally every combat and grows with your board
Lots of anthems (Allied Teamwork, White Lotus Reinforcements, Intangible Virtue)
Overrun ends games out of nowhere
weaknesses: Board wipes are the big danger: hold back a creature or two
Small creatures struggle against big blockers
Most removal is fight or exile-based, so few answers to enchantments

wins: Go wide with Allies and tokens. Suki's power equals the number of creatures you control and she brings a fresh 1/1 Ally into every attack, so the bigger the team, the harder she hits. Finish with Overrun or Appa, the Vigilant.
plan: Mana elves (Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic) or cheap Allies like Momo and Invasion Reinforcements.
Cast Suki. Add anthems and token makers: Allied Teamwork, Kyoshi Warriors, United Front.
Attack with Suki each turn: she makes a new Ally tapped and attacking. Earth King's Lieutenant and Avatar Enthusiasts grow as Allies join.
Overrun, Appa, the Vigilant or Champion of Lambholt lets the whole team through for the final swing.
keys: Power equal to the number of creatures you control; makes a 1/1 Ally token attacking alongside her each time she attacks.
Each Ally that enters gives your team +1/+1, flying and vigilance until end of turn.
An Ally token now and +1/+1 for every Ally.
Doubles every token you make, including Suki's.
Grows with each creature you add and stops small blockers from blocking.
tips: Tokens made by Suki, United Front and Kyoshi Warriors are Allies, so they trigger Ally abilities.
Keep one or two creatures in hand if an opponent has been holding cards: board wipes are the main way this deck loses.
Heroic Intervention saves your team from a wipe. Keep 2 mana open for it when you can.
Each time Suki returns from the command zone she costs 2 more.
mulligan: Keep 3 lands (or 2 lands and a mana elf) with a couple of 2- or 3-drops. Mulligan hands with no plays before turn 4.
